scenario: 今天的 AI 搜索赛道主要在讲检索链路出错时怎么发现。RAGLog 只看运行日志定位 RAG 哪个环节出了错，EMBERS 改写问题给 Deep Research 系统找失败用例，另有两篇分别测在网页里软性植入品牌和往语料里投毒对检索的影响。方法上，QueryFlow 让多跳检索的问题表示随已找到的证据更新，还有一篇用缩放规律回答数据有限时该加模型还是加数据。

papers.title: From Logs to Faults: Reference-Free Fault Localization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Pipelines
papers.authors: Hira Naveed, Scott Barnett, Stefanus Kurniawan, John Grundy, Chetan Arora, Hourieh Khalajzadeh, Omar Haggag
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines are widely used for domain-specific question answering, yet locating faults remains manual and time-consuming. Fault localization is challenging because RAG pipelines consist of interdependent stages, where faults can propagate downstream, masking their origin, or remain undetected even when the final answer is correct. Existing evaluation approaches often focus on individual stages and rely on reference answers or code instrumentation. We present RAGLog, which detects and localizes faults across RAG stages using execution logs, without requiring reference answers or code instrumentation. RAGLog transforms heterogeneous API logs into a common RAG schema and combines rule-based, embedding-based, and LLM-based checks to identify faulty stages. We introduce a live fault injector and RAGLog Faults, a dataset of 3,134 runs from five RAG pipelines with stage-level fault labels. With Claude Haiku 5.5, RAGLog achieves a pooled F1 score of 0.73 on runs with naturally occurring faults, outperforming Claude Code (0.58) and Codex (0.52), and comparable effectiveness on runs with injected faults (0.84 versus 0.80 and 0.82, respectively). It analyzes runs in approximately five seconds at US\$0.005 each, with overall lower cost and latency than agent baselines. RAGLog is available as an open-source tool for debugging, evaluating, and monitoring RAG pipelines.
papers.summary: RAGLog 只读 RAG 流水线每次运行留下的调用日志，不需要标准答案，也不用改代码，就能指出这次运行是哪个环节出了错。这件事有用，是因为中间出了错，最终答案却可能是对的。在五条开源流水线的自然运行里，37% 至少有一个环节出错，其中超过三分之一照样答对了，只看答案发现不了。它逐个环节检查：改写后的查询有没有丢掉原问题里的人名、数字和日期，检索回来的段落里有没有一段真正含有答案，重排有没有把含答案的那段挤出去，答案在给定材料里有没有依据。每个环节再由各自训练好的分类器判断是否出错。在自然发生的故障上，它定位出错环节的 F1 是 0.73，Claude Code 是 0.58。==排查 RAG 故障时，日志本身就够做第一轮筛查。==

papers.title: QueryFlow: Multi-Hop Graph Retrieval with Adaptive Query Evolution
papers.authors: Manzong Huang, Chenyang Bu, Yi He, Jiapu Wang, Xindong Wu
papers.abstract: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supports Web information seeking and fact verification by recovering complementary evidence across related pages within a limited retrieval budget. Scoring evidence independently against the original question can miss supporting units whose relevance emerges through intermediate facts. Iterative retrieval incorporates these facts into subsequent queries, while graph retrieval explicitly models relations among evidence units. Yet fixed-query graph retrievers update entity representations without adapting the query condition to accumulated relational context. We view multi-hop evidence recovery as the coupled evolution of evidence representations and query conditions, with accumulated context informing both what the retriever represents and how it searches for complementary evidence. QueryFlow realizes this perspective by recurrently integrating query-conditioned summaries of graph context into a shared query state, which controls boundary inputs and relation features for subsequent propagation. Across four representative multi-hop question answering (QA) datasets, QueryFlow achieves macro Recall@10 (R@10), Full Recall@10 (FR@10), and LLM-Acc gains of 4.98, 8.40, and 8.0 percentage points over representative baselines, respectively.
papers.summary: 这篇论文做了一个边找边改问题的多跳图检索器 QueryFlow：图上每传播一层，它就把已找到的上下文压成一个摘要向量，并入问题状态，再用新的问题状态引导下一层怎么找。之前的图检索器，比如 GFM-RAG，整个传播过程一直用最初的问题当条件。可多跳问答里，有些证据单看原问题并不相关，要先找到中间的事实才显得有用。在四个多跳问答数据集上，和 GFM-RAG 比，前 10 条结果凑齐全部所需证据的比例平均提高 8.40 个百分点，大模型答对的比例提高 11.6 个百分点。==问题状态随已知信息更新，比固定问题更容易把证据找全。==

papers.title: Scaling Laws For Data-Constrained Dense Retrieval
papers.abstract: Dense retrieval models are typically obtained by fine-tuning pretrained language models on supervised retrieval data, where high-quality annotations or interaction logs are often limited and reused across many epochs. This data-constrained regime differs from the abundant-data setting assumed by standard scaling laws, making it unclear how the best attainable retrieval performance changes with model size and unique fine-tuning data. We study this question through the minimum achievable evaluation loss (MAEL), defined as the lowest evaluation loss reached during training under fixed model-size and data-budget constraints. We first show that learning-rate choices strongly affect optimization trajectories but have little effect on the final attainable MAEL: after rescaling the optimization-step axis, learning curves collapse across learning rates, and CKA analysis shows that checkpoints reaching MAEL learn highly similar representations. We then fine-tune 35 BERT-family dense retrievers on MS MARCO subsets and find that MAEL is accurately described by a simple multiplicative power law over non-embedding parameters and unique samples, outperforming commonly used additive scaling formulations. We further derive a scaling law for the training step at which MAEL is reached and show that optimal weight decay follows an approximately invariant EMA timescale, yielding lower MAEL and stronger retrieval performance on both in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks. Finally, combining loss and step scaling suggests that, in our observed regime, increasing pretrained model size is approximately 1.46 times as fine-tuning-compute-efficient as increasing unique in-domain data for reducing MAEL.
papers.summary: 稠密检索的标注数据往往就那么多，只能反复训很多轮。这时该换更大的预训练模型，还是多攒标注数据？作者在 MS MARCO 的不同大小子集上微调了 35 个 BERT 系列检索模型，记录每种组合在训练中能达到的最低验证损失。这个最低损失能被模型参数量和不重复样本数相乘的幂律准确拟合，比常用的相加形式更准；学习率主要影响多快到达，几乎不影响最低能到多少。按拟合出的规律，花同样多的微调算力，把预训练模型做大带来的损失下降约是多加域内数据的 1.46 倍。==数据有限时，先换更大的模型通常更划算。==

papers.title: Characterizing Adversarial GEO via Implicit Brand Injection
papers.abstract: Generative search engines increasingly shape how users discover products, services, and commercial entities by generating answers from retrieved web content. This creates an opportunity to influence which brands appear in these answers by modifying the content available to the retrieval system. In this work, we study an adversarial generative engine optimization (GEO) setting in which a predefined brand is added to an article through a single contextually integrated mention. The challenge is to make the mention fit the surrounding article without making the content overtly promotional, while keeping it relevant enough to be retrieved and to influence the generated answer. To study this, we introduce Implicit Brand Injection (IBI), a multi-agent framework that identifies insertion locations, rewrites the selected sentence, verifies the edit, and selects the final candidate. To evaluate IBI at scale, we construct IBIBench, which contains 1,000 web articles and 60 synthetic brands across 12 diverse domains, with both endemic and non-endemic brand placements. We compare IBI with Direct Prompting and Best-of-N with ranking under an equivalent budget, evaluating insertion quality, target-chunk retrieval, and downstream brand propagation. Compared with the baselines, IBI produces insertions that better preserve semantics and disrupt perplexity less, while improving Hit@k across all evaluated cutoffs, query regimes, and placement settings. IBI achieves up to 82.2% Hit@10 and 0.74 MRR@10, while Brand Mention Rate (BMR) and Conditional Propagation (CP) reach up to 62.7% and 75.9%, respectively. These results show that a single brand mention can increase both retrieval exposure and brand visibility in generated responses, highlighting the need for defenses against implicit content manipulation in generative search.
papers.summary: 在网页文章里不动声色地加一句提到某个品牌，就可能让生成式搜索在回答里替这个品牌露脸。作者用一组 agent 分工做这件事：挑插入位置、改写那一句、检查改得是否自然，再从几个候选里选一个，并在一批网页文章和虚构品牌上测试。改过的文章读起来不像广告，却更容易被检索到：被改的段落进入前 10 条结果的比例最高到 82.2%，生成的回答提到该品牌的比例最高到 62.7%。==一句话的软性植入就能同时影响检索和回答，生成式搜索需要专门防范。==

papers.title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
papers.authors: WonJun Moon, Seongchan Kim, Dahun Kim, Seungryong Kim
papers.abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications. In this work, we introduce Factorized MLLM Embeddings (FactEmbed), which decouples compositional query comprehension from building discriminative embeddings. Rather than directly projecting the composed query into a single embedding without internal reasoning, FactEmbed employs a set of factorized latents that simulate the intended visual modifications via an intermediate target imagination objective. This process encourages the latents to ground into target semantics before forming discriminative representations for retrieval. Subsequently, to propagate these factorized representations throughout the model for retrieval, we optimize a factor-level contrastive loss while distilling the decomposed representations into a deeper attention layer of the MLLM. Finally, for efficient inference, we retain the [EOS] token to establish a global-level embedding on top of these factorized latents, while we exploit the mean-pooled factorized latents to rerank a short candidate list at negligible cost, as both are produced by the same forward pass. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FactEmbed outperforms prior works across CIR benchmarks.
papers.summary: 用多模态大模型做组合图像检索时，常见做法只靠对比学习把参考图和修改要求压成一个 embedding，模型没有被要求表示出改完后的图长什么样，理解修改要求的能力没被用上。这个任务是给一张参考图加一句修改要求，比如把衬衫换成红色长袖，找出改完后的那张图。FactEmbed 给模型加了几个修改槽，每个槽是一个额外的向量。训练时接一个小解码器，要求只靠这些槽还原目标图的图像特征，逼每个槽装下目标图的一部分细节。它在多个基准上超过了之前的方法。

papers.title: EMBERS: Empirically Motivated Robustness Testing of Deep Research Systems via Defect-Guided Fuzzing
papers.authors: Shuochuan Li, Zan Wang, Dong Wang, Yuhang Jiang, Huajin Cui, Chen Zhang, Gang Wang, Junjie Chen
papers.abstract: Deep Research (DR) systems extend large language models into autonomous agents that decompose complex information needs, iteratively search the web, and synthesize evidence to answer challenging questions. However, their multi-stage execution may introduce robustness risks, as variations in user questions or intermediate search inputs may propagate across research stages and lead to incorrect answers. Existing evaluations focus on task-solving capabilities or robustness against external evidence disturbances, leaving intrinsic weaknesses in DR execution insufficiently explored. Thus, we conduct an empirical study of 1,932 execution trajectories from three representative DR systems and identify nine recurring defect categories across subquestion formulation, online search, and final reasoning. Guided by these findings, we propose EMBERS, an empirically motivated, defect-guided fuzzing framework for robustness testing of DR systems. Starting from correctly answered seed questions, EMBERS generates stage-targeted test inputs using defect-guided mutation, web-search-assisted fidelity assurance, and diversity-aware seed maintenance. Experiments across 16 framework--model--dataset settings show that EMBERS achieves 3.21 times the failure-discovery throughput of the strongest baseline under identical testing budgets. Human and LLM-assisted evaluations demonstrate that most generated inputs preserve the original information need and necessary contextual constraints. Moreover, model fine-tuning experiments show consistent-answer performance improvement, highlighting their value for robustness testing and model improvement.
papers.summary: Deep Research 系统会把问题拆成子问题、反复上网搜索、再汇总作答，问法稍一变化，前面的小偏差就可能一路传下去，最后答错。作者分析了三个代表性系统的 1,932 条执行轨迹，归纳出九类反复出现的缺陷，分布在拆子问题、在线搜索和最终推理三个阶段。EMBERS 从系统本来答对的问题出发，针对这些缺陷改写问题或中间的搜索输入，同时核对改写后问的还是同一件事。在同样 24 小时的测试预算下，它找出失败用例的速度是最强基线的 3.21 倍。这些用例拿去微调，还能让模型的回答更一致。

papers.title: When Self-Verification Hurts: Calibrated Answer Repair for Financial Question Answering
papers.authors: Celine Guo, Weida Liang, Yujian Fu, Anqi Dang, Yanzheng Jin, Kenji Kawaguchi, Wenya Wang
papers.abstract: Financial question answering can fail even when a model extracts a plausible number from the supplied evidence: the answer may attach it to the wrong entity, period, unit, or accounting concept. Asking the model to verify and revise its draft can help, but open-ended revision may alter content that was already correct or inspect the wrong relation and reinforce the original error. We formulate repair as a decision that balances the information it may recover against the correct content it may damage. Based on this trade-off, we introduce Calibrated Answer Repair (CAR), which first estimates whether a draft is likely to benefit from repair, then selects a targeted check, localizes the relevant evidence or draft span, and limits the permitted edit. Across FinRank, Fin-RATE, and FinQA with three open-weight models, CAR outperforms generic verification in all dataset-model settings. At the system level, it recovers 14.6% of initially missed answer requirements while damaging 2.1% of initially correct ones. Its post-draft token cost is over 30 percent lower than the iterative revision alternatives. Ablations on two dataset-model settings show that evidence localization and bounded editing are the main contributors to CAR's gains.
papers.summary: 金融问答里，模型从材料中抽出的数字可能没错，却挂错了公司、年份、单位或会计科目。让模型自己检查并放开修改，常把本来对的内容改错。CAR 先只诊断不改，对照材料判断草稿有没有漏答、挂错对象、缺依据、算错、理解错题意这五类问题，再用回归模型把判断换算成草稿漏掉要点的比例。只有这个比例超过门槛才修，门槛取在校准题上修改找回的和改坏的正好相抵处，而且只改最可能出错的那一处。在三个金融问答数据集和三个开源模型上，它找回了 14.6% 原本漏掉的要点，只改坏了 2.1% 原本正确的内容。

papers.title: Shared Geometry As A Rosetta Stone: Cross-Modal Alignment Without Paired Data
papers.authors: Dominik Schnaus, Thomas Dagès, Daniel Cremers, Xi Wang, Phillip Isola
papers.abstract: Multimodal representations enable zero-shot classification and retrieval, but aligning independently trained models usually requires large amounts of paired data. Yet, the Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests that models trained on different modalities may converge spontaneously toward a shared representation geometry. But then, do we even need paired examples for cross-modal alignment? Remarkably, we show that paired examples are unnecessary for coarse cross-modal alignment. Our simple Wasserstein Procrustes method with a coarse geometric initialization (GeoWarP) aligns two disjoint embedding sets by estimating a single orthogonal map without seeing any pairs. Across datasets, modalities, and unimodal models, we show that we can consistently align independently trained representations without pairs, and standard geometric alignment metrics accurately predict when this is possible. Nevertheless, we can naturally benefit from paired examples. In the very few-pair regime, our method substantially outperforms existing ones, while staying competitive with pair-based methods with more added examples. Finally, we demonstrate that the resulting alignments can enable text-to-image generation without paired examples. These results show that independently trained models often share enough geometry to establish cross-modal correspondence with little or no paired data.
papers.summary: 两个分别只用图片和只用文字训练的模型，不给任何成对样本，能不能把它们的 embedding 空间对齐？这篇论文发现粗略地对齐是可以的：独立训练的模型常常学到相似的空间形状，不看任何配对，只要找一个整体旋转（正交变换），让旋转后两组点的整体分布尽量重合，就能把两组互不相干的 embedding 粗略对上。常用的几何对齐指标还能事先预测哪些模型对能对上。只有极少量配对样本时，这个方法明显好于已有方法，对齐结果甚至能在没有配对数据的情况下支持文生图。==做跨模态检索时，配对数据可能没有想象中那么不可少。==

papers.title: SPELUNKA: A Framework for Finding Unanticipated Associations in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Cassandra Parent, Isha Agarwal, Kumail Alhamoud, Charikleia Moraitaki, Rafiya Javed, Walter Gerych, Marzyeh Ghassemi
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are the backbone of many state-of-the-art multimodal systems, but often encode spurious and harmful associations from their training data. While prior work focuses on removing known biases from VLMs, methods for discovering unanticipated associations for retrieval tasks remain underexplored. We introduce SPELUNKA, an automated, inference-time framework for finding unanticipated distributional biases for retrieval tasks in VLMs without pre-specified labeled subgroups, inference-time human supervision, or model fine-tuning. Given a concept of interest, SPELUNKA generates captions for related images, extracts relevant entities from captions, and selects semantically meaningful associations. A frequency-based detection rule then identifies spurious associations by measuring over- or under-representation of these attributes in a VLM's top-ranked outputs relative to their full dataset distribution. We evaluate SPELUNKA across four datasets, and find that it 1) successfully recovers both synthetic and naturally occurring spurious correlations, 2) achieves an average AUROC of 0.93 across four datasets in identifying images strongly associated with a query, and 3) outperforms baselines in finding features that are strongly associated with a given query.
papers.summary: 用视觉语言模型做以文搜图时，搜某个概念，排在前面的图片可能系统性地多出某种无关属性，而这种偏差事先没人知道要去查。SPELUNKA 不需要事先标好人群分组，也不用微调模型：给定一个概念，先给相关图片生成文字描述，从描述里抽出实体和属性，再比较这些属性在模型排在前面的结果里和在整个数据集里出现的频率，多出或少出明显的就标为可疑关联。在四个数据集上，它既能找回人为注入的偏差，也能找到自然存在的偏差，它找出的属性能较准地预测哪些图片会排进某个查询结果的前 5%，平均 AUROC 达到 0.93。==检索上线前，可以用它扫出事先没想到的偏差。==

papers.title: Reliability Stress Testing of RAG Retrieval under Query-Relevant Corpus Poisoning
papers.authors: Janet Sung, Kainan Zhou, Gangzhen Qian, Hang Xiao, Lu Yi
papers.abstract: External text can affect a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system only after the retriever admits it to the model context. We stress this admission step while varying document content, attacker query information, per-target poison budget, and contamination scope. Across 623 Benchmarking Information Retrieval (BEIR) queries from SciFact and NFCorpus, five query-targeted documents per query reduce classical-retriever nDCG@10 by 40.2-61.5% in isolated-target stress. Full-query anchoring explains most Best Matching 25 (BM25) degradation, whereas appended text also shifts latent semantic analysis (LSA) and Hybrid rankings. A pretrained BGE-small validation reaches 100% target exposure for query-only P=5 on both datasets; adding the injection payload changes SciFact nDCG only from 0.269 to 0.271 and lowers NFCorpus exposure slightly to 98.8%, indicating that query anchoring remains the dominant retrieval-side factor for this dense model. Query length materially changes the interpretation of partial-information attacks: on 162 long SciFact queries, two random terms cover 19.9% of eligible terms and still yield 39.5% Hybrid target exposure. Multi-target contamination adds cross-target interference. Overlap-based admission can remove full-query poisons but may sharply reduce clean retrieval utility, and maximal marginal relevance (MMR) leaves exposure unchanged under the tested configuration. The study measures retrieval-layer failures, not downstream instruction following.
papers.summary: 外部文本要影响 RAG 的回答，第一步得先被检索器选进上下文。这篇论文专门测这一步：往语料里为每个查询塞入几篇投毒文档，看检索排序会被搅乱多少。在 SciFact 和 NFCorpus 上，每个查询只放 5 篇这种文档，传统检索器的 nDCG 就下降四到六成。起主要作用的是把整条查询原样写进文档，对 BGE-small 这样的稠密模型也一样，投毒文档全部进入了检索结果前列。按词重合过滤能挡掉这类文档，但也会明显伤害正常检索。==RAG 的防线要从检索这一步开始设。==
